text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Victory at the Oka Sho... slipped right 
through my fingers."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gritting my teeth in sheer frustration, I 
still declare it clearly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both Air Messiah and myself. We did 
everything we possibly could. Earnestly, 
without letting our guard down, and 
steadily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So it's simple. —They just outperformed 
me. My rivals' growth simply exceeded my 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*——......*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, you're right. We must learn 
from our mistakes. However, we cannot let 
regret stop us in our tracks.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Defeat is the most crucial opportunity to 
learn. I will make full use of it... for 
my next victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our Oka Sho alongside Air Messiah 
ended in a heartbreaking result, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, even with the Oka Sho behind 
me, I cannot afford to let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open "Race_Schedule_5" in the shared 
cloud folder and type into the main goal 
field. —"The Oaks".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara has only just finished 
its first race...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
By late next month, the second leg, the 
Oaks, will already be upon us.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The longest of the Triple Tiara at 2,400 
meters... There is no doubt that this race 
will test our fundamental stamina even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And as I mentioned before—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The final leg of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho, is a race that holds 
significant meaning for me.
choice_data_list: We can't let our guard down just yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... First, let us make adjustments for 
the Oaks. I'll be in your care.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Heading into the Oaks, stamina training 
is definitely the top priority... I need 
to structure my self-training around that 
too—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~~, seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
For real, for real! The press conference 
video is already out! You gotta check it 
out too!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No way... wait, that's incredible! Line 
Craft-chan, are you for real...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (? ...Craft-san?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The press conference footage... Is this 
it?)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"D-Does that mean...! You intend to change 
course at this stage!?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I'm still thinking about the Shuka 
Sho... but at the very least, I won't be 
running in the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm heading for the 'NHK Mile Cup'!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because out there is a path that only I 
can run... A brilliance that only I can 
show!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I want to forge my own path! With these 
legs! With my running!"
